characteristics.spring: Your aura radiates bright and vibrant energy. Like warm spring sunlight, you overflow with vitality.
characteristics.summer: A soft and elegant energy flows through your aura. Like summer mist, you possess a subtle mystique.
characteristics.autumn: Deep and abundant energy resides within you. Like autumn foliage, you carry a mature allure.
characteristics.winter: Sharp and striking energy fills your aura. Like a winter snowscape, you possess a vivid presence.
seasonOmen.spring.0: The vibrant energy of spring blossoms dwells within you.
seasonOmen.spring.1: You carry the warmth of spring sunlight — brighten your energy with vivid colors.
seasonOmen.spring.2: Like sprouting buds, your charm blossoms more each day.
seasonOmen.summer.0: A mystical energy like summer mist surrounds you.
seasonOmen.summer.1: You reflect the gentle moonlight — soft hues will make you shine.
seasonOmen.summer.2: Your pure energy, clear as water, draws people to you.
seasonOmen.autumn.0: Deep and rich energy, like autumn foliage, resides within you.
seasonOmen.autumn.1: You carry the earth's warmth — natural colors will harmonize with you.
seasonOmen.autumn.2: Like ripening fruit, your mature charm stands out.
seasonOmen.winter.0: Sharp and mystical energy, like a winter night sky, dwells within you.
seasonOmen.winter.1: You are as clear as snow — bold colors will enhance your radiance.
seasonOmen.winter.2: You carry cold moonlight within — your striking allure captivates the world.
